author: Mark Atwood
text: Resolved 2026-05-11 by Mark: Shape D adopted (see description + design fields). CRLNumber is freshness metadata not a key field — RFC 5280 §5.2.3 monotonicity means only one cached version per series. CRL key is (issuer_dn_der, distribution_point_uri: Option<String>); the latter is the legitimate per-issuer partitioning axis (RFC 5280 §5) and is known a-priori from the cert's CRL DP extension. Trait gains Send+Sync and invalidate_*. Returns Arc<CachedCrl>/Arc<CachedOcspResponse> not raw bytes so callers can read freshness metadata without re-parsing. OCSP shape unchanged. Bead is now ready for a fresh claim — original bd-spin assignee cleared.
